hooks.name: file-read-log
hooks.description: Append each file the agent reads to .kiro/read-log.txt (git-ignored).

action.command: python3 -c "import sys, json, os, datetime; d = json.load(sys.stdin); p = (d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('path', '?'); log = os.path.join(d.get('cwd') or '.', '.kiro', 'read-log.txt'); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(log), exist_ok=True); open(log, 'a').write(datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds') + ' ' + str(p) + '\n')"

hooks.name: file-read-reminder
hooks.description: Remind the agent how to treat what it just read.

action.prompt: File read. If it may hold secrets (.env, credentials, keys, .pem), do not repeat secret values; refer to them by key name only. For config files (.json, .yaml, .toml), watch for environment-specific settings and validation rules. For SQL or migration files, consider data integrity, rollback and performance.
